external_references.signal_use: descriptive genome-wide and preregistered-locus concordance only

contig_policy.comparison_universe: intersection of GENCODE FASTA and external-reference contigs
contig_policy.absent_external_records: exclude without renaming and report records plus covered bases
contig_policy.null_universe: same shared contigs as the observed comparison

encode_overlap_null.method: uniform relocation within chromosome, exact width, and exact GC-base-count strata
encode_overlap_null.operational_gc_definition: exact integer count of G plus C bases in the interval
encode_overlap_null.gc_class_definition: deciles [0.0,0.1), [0.1,0.2), ..., [0.9,1.0], retained only as descriptive superclasses
encode_overlap_null.ambiguous_bases: candidate intervals containing non-ACGT bases are ineligible
encode_overlap_null.eligible_genome: shared comparison contigs excluding ENCFF356LFX blacklist intervals and non-ACGT sequence
encode_overlap_null.sampling: two-stage design: deterministic uniform rejection sampling constructs each frozen eligible candidate pool, followed by uniform sampling without replacement within each chromosome-width-exact-GC-count stratum per null set
encode_overlap_null.aggregate_gc_repair: forbidden; exact per-region GC-base-count preservation makes aggregate GC exact by construction
encode_overlap_null.minimum_candidate_pool: max(200, 20 * observed peaks in each chromosome-width-GC group)
validation_phases: capacity-only preflight for exact-GC strata; do not generate nulls or calculate RN3
generate and audit nulls without RN3
repeat with the same implementation and seed; require identical null-set SHA-256
freeze null sets and calculate RN3 exactly once

diversity_gates.maximum_reuse: group-specific Binomial(100, k_g/M_g) quantile with global family-wise alpha 0.01

retired_generator_v2.method: GC-decile-uniform sampling plus aggregate balanced swaps

encode_overlap_null.failure_policy: if exact-GC capacity or structural validation fails, RN3 is NOT_EVALUABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_CONTROL_REQUIREMENTS

motif.test: one-sided Mann-Whitney U on maximum PWM log-odds scores

preregistered_locus.name: K562 beta-globin regulatory region
preregistered_locus.role: qualitative positive control, not an independent release gate
